about: Patch releases for the 3DS game とんがりボウシと魔法の町 (Tongari Boushi to Mahou no Machi). Same shape as patches.json: newest release first. Each download is a link to the patch file (host it in the public bucket under patches/3ds/, or any public URL) plus optional checksums.
statusNote: Patches for the 3DS game are available in Italian and English.

releases.headline: An updated English translation
releases.summary: The complete English translation, now with the 147 download-only items and 24 shops built in. Works on the Azahar emulator and on a 3DS with Luma3DS.
releases.notes: Patch it right on this page: choose English, then Azahar to get the patched ROM, or 3DS (Luma3DS) to get the luma folder for the SD card. You can also download the .xdelta and apply it with Delta Patcher.

releases.headline: The first release: the whole game in Italian
releases.summary: A complete Italian translation, with a few changes that make the game more comfortable to play. Works on the Azahar emulator and on a 3DS with Luma3DS. Saves stay compatible.
changes: Everything is in Italian: dialogue, menus, items, names, shop signs, lesson blackboards, the Spell & Spill magazine, titles and credits, redrawn in the original style.
Dialogue uses feminine forms when you play as a girl.
Three-line dialogue boxes, full clothing names, a 24-hour clock, and a name keyboard that opens on Latin letters and accepts the names the old word filter rejected.
Shops and services are open around the clock, and lessons work at any hour.
You can date or become best friends with anyone, of any sex.
Fast travel from the village map.
Hold B to show text instantly.
A new Options menu, asked to the teachers or to Reginaldo: infinite money, stable bonds, new stock in shops, spells that don't use up materials.
One patch for both the original game (Ver.1.0) and the Ver.1.1 update.
releases.notes: Patch it right on this page: choose Azahar to get the patched ROM, or 3DS (Luma3DS) to get the luma folder for the SD card. You can also download the .xdelta and apply it with Delta Patcher, or use the full package for Windows, which makes both offline. Instructions and source code are on GitHub (chokercrave/mahou-no-machi-patch).
